data.title: ASUS Unleashes Second Wave of Back-to-School Deals: Up to 50% Off Through September 10
data.description: ASUS is set to launch its second phase of Back-to-School promotions in Canada starting on August 21 and running until September 10. During this period, customers can enjoy heavy discounts on laptops, with prices starting as low as C$699 and savings of up to C$2,650 on selected models. Additionally, Chromebooks will be available for purchase starting at C$229. This limited-time offer provides an excellent opportunity for those in Canada looking to buy laptops or Chromebooks at significantly reduced prices before the school year begins.

data.title: Elevra Lithium Completes Binding Supply Agreement with Mangrove Lithium
data.description: Elevra Lithium Limited, a North American lithium producer, recently signed a binding Spodumene Concentrate Supply Agreement with Mangrove Lithium for the long-term supply of spodumene concentrate from North American Lithium in Québec. The agreement involves Elevra trading under the tickers ASX:ELV and NASDAQ:ELVR. This deal signifies a significant development for the industry, potentially impacting the supply chain. The specific details regarding the volume of supply and financial terms were not disclosed at this time. This agreement is a crucial step for Elevra in solidifying its position in the market and establishing itself as a key player in the lithium sector.

data.title: Banuba Advances Real-Time AR Beauty With More Natural Skin Smoothing and Virtual Makeup

The improvements in the SDK are designed to create a seamless on-camera experience, promoting a more polished and professional look.

data.title: CoStar Group Completes Acquisition of Zonda, Expanding into New Home Data, Analytics and Online Marketplaces
data.description: A provider of online real estate services CoStar Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: CSGP) based in ARLINGTON, Va. has successfully acquired Zonda for $800 million in cash. Zonda is recognized for new home construction data, homebuilder software, and residential real estate marketplaces. The acquisition bolsters CoStar Group's reach in the residential real estate sector and enhances its offerings with 3D digital twin technology.

data.title: Charmin is Officially Putting Bad Roommate Bathroom Behavior on Trial with the Forever Roll
data.description: In Cincinnati, shared living can lead to tension among roommates, especially when it comes to small things like replacing an empty toilet paper roll. Charmin is addressing this common issue with the Roommate Trials campaign, aiming to help roommates resolve disputes by introducing the Forever Roll. This extra-large roll ensures that no one is left stranded in the bathroom, emphasizing the importance of having a constant supply of toilet paper in shared living spaces. The campaign emphasizes the significance of this simple act of consideration in maintaining harmony among roommates.

data.title: Why Hot-State Homeowners Are Choosing Wood Pergolas Over Aluminum -- It's Not About Looks
data.description: In Payson, Utah, on August 21, 2026, a report reveals a surge in the outdoor living trend in the Sun Belt region. A notable concern is emerging in the pergola market regarding safety. It has been observed that metal surfaces exposed to direct sunlight can lead to contact burns within seconds, whereas heavy timber materials prove to be safer to touch. This has sparked a significant shift in the market, prompting companies like Western Timber Frame™ from Utah to reassess their product offerings.

data.title: Hasanuddin University Study Maps Indonesia's Seagrass Ecosystems from Hotspots to Refugia
data.description: In Makassar, Indonesia, a recent study conducted on 21 seagrass meadows in Central and Eastern Indonesia has uncovered a diverse ecological landscape. The assessment, published in Science of..., highlighted a wide variation in the health of these areas, with some remaining relatively healthy while others were found to be degraded. The study sheds light on the importance of conserving these ecosystems, as they play a critical role in the region's biodiversity.

data.title: Caputo Flour Brings Authentic Italian Baking to Woodman's Food Markets, Now Available Across All 20 Stores
